jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Every year, companies spend over a trillion dollars moving freight across the U.S. but the system for matching trucks with jobs is still slow, manual, and fragmented. FleetWorks is fixing that.

We're building products that transform the chaotic freight booking process into a modern, intelligent, agentic marketplace. Our agents replace the endless phone calls, texts, and emails and match truckers who want to get paid with loads that need to be moved.

We have a small, high-agency team working out of our office in SOMA. As an early engineer, you will be a true owner of your work, developing features end to end, interacting directly with our customers, and shaping our culture.

What you'll do

  • Own end-to-end feature development, working directly with a high-ownership team including our founders, customers, and other engineers

  • Make product and technical decisions that will shape the future of FleetWorks

  • Ship new work every day

  • Learn from others and teach those around you

What we look for

  • Professional experience owning end-to-end feature development on customer-facing products

  • At least 3 years of professional full-time software development experience

  • Comfort working in our stack or picking it up quickly, we use TypeScript across the stack

  • A healthy appreciation for hard problems, we orchestrate thousands of agents and are just getting started!

  • Empathy for your users and your colleagues

How we'll get to know each other

  • Quick call with Megan, our Talent Lead, for you to share your goals and motivations, what you’ve worked on that you’re proud of and to figure out together how that might fit in with what we’re working on at FleetWorks

  • 45-min live-coding interview with an engineer who you'll work with if you join, so that we can get to know how you think about technical challenges

  • Paid onsite work trial so that we can get to know how you work and you can get to know us

  • Transparent offer process that clearly outlines how we came to the compensation package we’re offering, including the current and potential value of your equity

What we offer

  • Top tier cash and equity compensation—we aim to be above 75th %ile for companies who have raised a similar amount of cash

  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits

  • Fully covered lunches and dinners

  • The opportunity to learn quickly, grow fast, and be rewarded for your contributions

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Every year, companies spend over a trillion dollars moving freight across the U.S - yet the system for matching trucks with jobs is still slow, manual, and fragmented. FleetWorks is fixing that.

We’re building omni-channel agents that turn the chaotic freight booking process into a modern, intelligent marketplace. Carriers and brokers, often small businesses and owner-operators, are the foundation of that system. Unlocking widespread adoption is one of the highest-leverage opportunities in the company and a core driver of our long-term trajectory.

We’re looking for a Product Manager who has owned and scaled products that became the industry standard, someone who knows what excellence looks like because they’ve built it. This is not an incremental role. You’ll partner with the CEO and founding team to refine the vision, strategy, and execution for our marketplace products for both carriers and brokers and 100s of thousands of AI powered interactions per day.

What you’ll do:

  • Refine the vision, strategy, and roadmap for our broker AI product lines alongside the founders.

  • Drive execution end to end, partnering closely with engineering, operations, and GTM to ship fast, iterate, and deliver measurable results.

  • Set the bar for product excellence, establishing how we scope, prioritize, launch, and learn as we scale the product and the team.

What we look for:

  • A product manager with a history of building high-impact, category-defining products.

  • A 1→10 builder who thrives in ambiguity, scales products from first principles, and makes fast, high-judgment calls.

  • Experience working with data in an AI-first environment. It’s more important to know the right questions to ask rather than writing syntax-perfect SQL

  • Experience working with customers - scaling adoption and stewarding customers through change management

  • A systems thinker with strong customer instincts, comfortable with both ground-truth insights and data.

  • An owner with a founder’s mindset, operating close to the work and holding an exceptionally high bar.

What we offer

  • Top tier cash and equity compensation—we aim to be above 75th %ile for companies who have raised a similar amount of cash

  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits

  • Fully covered lunches and dinners

  • The opportunity to learn quickly, grow fast, and be rewarded for your contributions

jobs.title: Head of Customer Deployments
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Every year, companies spend over a trillion dollars moving freight across the U.S. but the system for matching trucks with jobs is still slow, manual, and fragmented. FleetWorks is fixing that.

Our customers are freight brokers, and every one of them runs a little differently. Getting a new customer from signed contract to a working, adopted product means learning how they operate, deciding what we're building for them, keeping the project moving across their team and ours, and managing expectations on both sides. Today that work is spread across customer success, engineering, and the founders. We’re looking for a Head of Deployments to own the technical customer journey through onboarding & implementation and custom builds that power our customers’ core business.

You'll personally run our most important implementations and write the playbook from what you learn. You'll be the person who scopes what we're committing to, sets expectations with the customer, and balances them against what engineering can deliver.


What You'll do

  • Own Customer Deployments at the intersection of of customers and engineering. This includes onboarding as well as new product features, rollouts, etc

  • You’ll own customer implementations end to end: from contract signature through onboarding, go-live, and steady-state adoption.

  • Partner with engineering and product leadership on changes that reduce engineering’s role in customer builds

  • Work with Product to train and enable customers, including building documentation that will help users self-serve.

  • Build a project management system that can be used across Product, CS, and Engineering to keep up to date on current status of customer builds. Be the owner of escalations between engineering and CS.

  • Scope the work and manage expectations. Turn what a customer wants into clear, realistic requirements engineering can build against. Scope how integrations work, with customers and with partners.

  • Learn the product deeply. Get hands-on enough to configure workflows and agents yourself at the start, and know when a one-off should become a product feature.

  • Own the rollout and the custom workflows that drive expansion with existing customers. This also includes enablement, training, and documentation that lets customers get more value without waiting on us.

  • Manage and develop the deployment team, starting with our deployment strategist.

What We Look For

  • Experience owning implementation, solutions, or another technical customer-facing delivery role at B2B software companies.

  • Experience managing technical customer relationships at a level where you could coach others on it, and a track record that engineers will trust.

  • Technical enough to learn a complex product deeply, configure workflows, read an integration, and ask engineers the right questions.

  • Operator's instincts. You understand how a business runs, you care about your customer's margins, and you spot issues before they become a problem.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication.

  • High ownership and hands-on by default. You'd rather do the first version yourself than write a plan for someone else to execute.

What we offer

  • Top tier cash and equity compensation—we aim to be above 75th %ile for companies who have raised a similar amount of cash

  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits

  • Fully covered lunches and dinners

  • The opportunity to learn quickly, grow fast, and be rewarded for your contributions
